name: half-rate
description: The game runs 30 frames a second at its real speed: it waits two screen refreshes per frame and steps its simulation twice, as it did on the PS3 when it couldn't hold 60. About half the frames to work out, so a lot less CPU. Turn Frame generation on (launcher, Display) and the graphics card fills the picture back up to 60.

*.note: lwz r4,0x1C(r9) -> li r4,2: the frame pacer waits two refreshes (found by its code, so every release)
